Signet

Ten starter designs for animated email signatures that work in Gmail and Outlook. Each one is table-based HTML with inline styles; only the outlined part is animated, and in the real signature it ships as a hosted GIF.

Your details

Used for the GIF and the links

Copied signatures point to [host]/[design].gif. Replace it with where you upload the rendered GIFs.

Signatures stay under Gmail's 10,000-character limit. Text, phone numbers and links stay live HTML so they remain clickable and readable when images are blocked.
